source.db_note: the app history DB on the machine that built it (outcomes + cache + token_snapshots); not shipped

label_rule: recorder outcome at 259200s (keyless proxy, labeler 0.2.0); bad = rug ∪ dead, ok = flat ∪ fade ∪ runner; unobserved dropped
evidence_rule: link features from the cached DexScreener/Jupiter token record only when it was fetched within 3600s after the row's t0 (latest such t0 per coin); rug-check features from that t0 snapshot
split_rule: by time: the latest 30% of rows by t0 (t0 ≥ 2026-10-12T21:28:23.575Z) are the held-out TEST split, fixed before tuning
